title: "Rigid Pavements"

This section focuses on Jointed Concrete Pavement (JPC) response, load transfer, slab rocking, curling and warping, moving and dynamic loads, Traffic Speed Deflectometer (TSD) response, composite pavements, finite-element modeling, and analytical beam formulations.
